added_by_protocol_2: answer_parts: a multi-part answer gives each fact for its own part (ccl.verify.parts_ok)
shortcut: no probe and hit on one column of a list (ccl.verify.shortcut)
acceptance_rule.applies_to: every buffer of every arm, a teacher's demonstrations included
